decisions.statement: Somebody could have settled a declaration otherwise.
A seat reading a declaration off its own surroundings has a declaration still.
A seat's attributes have one store.
Every other place a seat's attributes appear is written from that store.
An attribute nobody stated is that attribute's default rather than absent.
A seat's charter is the terms the seat was made on.
A seat's principal is who the seat's output is produced for.
A principal nobody stated is absent rather than a default.
A seat's principal does not change when the seat's mode does.
A seat with a terminal attached is interactive.
A seat with no terminal attached is headless.
A seat's flex tells apart two seats stating the same attributes.
A flex value is `flex-` followed by a number.
Only a spawned seat has a flex.
A seat's spawner assigns that seat's flex.
A seat is on call or sent to a piece of work or both at once.
An assignment is set and changed only by the seat's principal.
A seat whose principal is Alan writes its own assignment at his direction.
An assignment ends when the work the assignment names is done.
An assignment ends when the next to act has been told.
Every assignment is stated on the seat.
A seat on call is there for its principal whether or not the principal is working.
A seat of either mode can be on call.
Every seat started in interactive mode is on call for Alan.
A seat on call is started by that seat's principal.
Being on call names no work to finish.
Being on call ends only where the seat's principal or Alan ends the seat's being on call.
Work a principal hands a seat that no task or initiative names is an errand.
The prompt a seat was started with is that seat's errand until its principal states a new errand.
Nothing observable ends an errand.
A seat is assigned one initiative.
An initiative a persona picked up ends on measurement rather than on delivery.
An assignment that has ended is no longer stated on the seat.
A seat is stopped once the seat's dispatch has ended.

definition: what a seat has because somebody set it
